key_insight: EchoChat is a multimodal generative AI model that supports comprehensive echocardiographic interpretation across 33 cardiac conditions and findings.
clinical_relevance: In a source-blinded reader study, EchoChat-assisted reports improved diagnostic F1 from 72.78% to 82.75% compared with routine-reader-only reports.
method: Trained on echocardiography–instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations.
Combines echocardiographic visual evidence with medical knowledge and explicit reasoning.
Evaluated condition recognition, quantification, and clinician-assisted report generation.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered cohorts from six international medical centers; 15 newly added conditions achieved an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations.
watch_item: Prospective workflow validation is needed before assuming these performance gains translate into safer care or better patient outcomes.
paper_title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
